What actually works, reviewed 2026-10-25. Edit `docs/status.yaml` and run `python scripts/gen_status.py`; CI fails if this page is stale. A **works** row must cite evidence that exists in the repo.

Statuses: **works** (implemented end to end), **partial** (known gaps or untested), **broken** (implemented but cannot succeed), **stub** (placeholder), **absent**.
